title: WhalesIslandReef D18 runtime promotion request
description: Static, machine-verifiable REQUEST for future Runtime promotion of a D18 logic asset record (D18-L37). It expresses only a request: asset_id, current_state (IntakeEligible or RuntimeRequested only), target_usage_scene, descriptors, requirements, approver, risks, rollback and submitted_at. This schema CANNOT express any grant: it has no approval-result field, no approval-status field, no target state, and declares_approval is fixed to false. RuntimeApproved and ReleaseApproved can never be produced by or through this schema; a valid request produces only a RUNTIME_REQUEST audit record in the logic phase.

repo_relative_path.description: Repository-relative path only. Absolute paths, drive letters (C:), UNC names (\\server), backslashes, leading slashes, whitespace and '..' traversal segments are forbidden.

request_kind.description: Fixed discriminator; distinguishes this schema from manifests, catalogs, descriptors and result JSON.

asset_id.description: Business key of the asset being requested, referencing the D18-L02 canonical_asset_id. Never a disk path or display name.

current_state.description: State of the asset at request time. Only IntakeEligible (first request) and RuntimeRequested (re-request) are legal; Candidate direct requests are an illegal overstep and approval states are never requestable.

target_usage_scene.description: Identifier of the controlled work scene / Prefab the request targets (D19-D22 consumer scope). A request has no target state: promotion targets a usage scene, never an approval.

descriptors.description: References to the D18-L25-L29 descriptor records (mesh / material / animation / ui_audio). At least one evidence reference is required; missing references make the request invalid.

requirements.description: Declared collision / LOD / animation requirements for the future Runtime consumer. Declarations only; they create nothing.

approver.description: Responsible human approver role. Tools can never be approvers (tool:<...> is rejected by pattern).

risks.description: Honest risk list for the requested usage. An empty risk list is invalid.

rollback.description: Mandatory rollback statement: reference must be the placeholder content id or an asset record id, description explains the degradation if the request is declined or the asset fails at Runtime.

submitted_at.description: Request submission time, ISO-8601 with timezone.

declares_approval.description: Fixed false. This schema expresses a request only and can never declare any approval; any true value is invalid by construction.
